label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness) is a True Positive: the sink expression 'rememberMeKey' at line 101 directly receives the output of 'new java.util.Random().nextInt(99)', which is insecure randomness used for session token generation. The resolved sink value depends entirely on attacker-controlled random input. Alert 2 (java/xss) is also a True Positive: the sink expressions at lines 110-115 concatenate 'rememberMeKey' (derived from user cookie value) and 'rememberMe.getValue()' (also derived from user cookie value) into the HTTP response stream via response.getWriter().println(), allowing XSS injection.
